name: zopt_get_object_lod_for_current_hw_mode
description: zOpt::GetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode returns the software or hardware ObjectLOD option according to the active hardware mode.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this option getter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zOpt/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408030 validates reading g_zOpt_HwMode and returning *ZOPT_OBJECT_LOD_SW for software mode or *ZOPT_OBJECT_LOD_HW for hardware mode.
The native smoke verifies both software and hardware object-LOD values through SetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode and GetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode.
